job.title: Senior Project Manager - CRM
job.description:
Senior Project Manager – CRM Delivery
12 month FTC 

Are you an experienced Senior Project Manager ready to take ownership of a prestigious account?

We’re looking for a proactive and commercially minded Senior Project Manager with a strong background in managing high-volume CRM communications, specifically email and direct mail (DM), from initial brief through to final delivery.

In this role, you’ll lead the end-to-end delivery of CRM communications, acting as the central point of contact across client services, strategy, creative, copy, design, production and deployment teams. You’ll oversee project workflows, manage budgets and timelines, and build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring all communications are delivered accurately, efficiently and on time.
What You’ll Do
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of CRM communications across email and direct mail, from briefing and planning through to production, approval and final delivery.
  • Manage multiple projects and high-volume creative briefs simultaneously, ensuring all deliverables meet agreed deadlines, budgets and quality standards.
  • Own project scope, timelines, budgets and resource planning, proactively identifying risks and resolving issues before they escalate.
  • Coordinate the development and delivery of CRM assets, working closely with copy, creative, design, production and relevant technical teams.
  • Manage stakeholder reviews, feedback and approval processes, ensuring all communications meet client requirements and brand guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, including project plans, cost estimates, resource bookings and delivery schedules.
  • Work closely with client leadership and account teams to manage incoming briefs, forecast workload and balance priorities against team capacity.
  • Monitor project budgets, revenue reconciliation and project spend in collaboration with finance and account teams.
  • Ensure email and direct mail communications are delivered accurately, with strong attention to detail across content, data, personalisation, formats and final production requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, streamline processes and enhance the efficiency and quality of CRM delivery.
About You
  • Experienced: Currently operating at Senior Project Manager level, with experience managing complex, high-volume projects from briefing through to delivery. Experience in CRM, email and direct mail communications is essential.
  • Highly Organised: Comfortable managing multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously, with exceptional attention to detail.
  • A Strong Relationship Builder: Confident working with clients and cross-functional teams, building trusted relationships and communicating effectively at all levels.
  • Commercially Minded: Experienced in managing budgets, project costs, resource allocation and financial reporting.
  • A Proactive Problem Solver: Able to anticipate challenges, manage changing priorities and find practical solutions in a fast-paced environment.
  • Process Driven: Experienced in project management methodologies, systems and workflows, with a focus on accuracy, efficiency and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborative: Skilled at coordinating creative, copy, design, production and technical teams to deliver high-quality CRM communications.
  • An Excellent Communicator: Persuasive, empathetic and intellectually curious, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to translate complex briefs into clear delivery plans.
You’ll thrive in a role that combines creative project management with operational precision, taking ownership of CRM communications delivery and ensuring every email and direct mail campaign is delivered seamlessly, accurately and on time.

job.title: Senior Financial Controller- Fashion Retail Brand
job.description:
The Senior Financial Controller acts as the CFO’s number 2, overseeing the day-to-day management and operation of the Finance function.

The role is responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, maintaining robust financial controls, and managing the core processes that support the smooth running of the business.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-growing, dynamic environment where systems and processes are continually evolving. The successful candidate will be adaptable, commercially minded and comfortable responding to changing priorities, while establishing clear processes, strengthening financial controls and supporting the business’s continued growth.

This is an initial contract role, with the view to extend and ideally become permanent.

Please still apply if you are only interested in contract work.
  • Immediate start
  • Monthly rolling contract- could be long term contract or convert to a permanent role if it suits long term
  • 3 days in the London office
  • Circa £85k + 
The role:
  • Oversee the day-to-day Finance function, serving as the primary point of contact and escalation for finance-related matters.
  • Lead, support and develop the Finance team, establishing clear responsibilities, priorities, deadlines and expectations for accuracy, quality and accountability.
  • Communicate effectively across departments, fostering strong working relationships and addressing issues promptly, collaboratively and pragmatically.
  • Take ownership of routine operational finance matters, ensuring they are resolved efficiently within the team and enabling the CFO to focus on strategic priorities, funding, Board and investor relations, and key commercial decisions.
  • Lead the monthly and quarterly financial close and reporting cycle, including P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reporting, across multiple entities
  • Ensure the integrity and consistency of historical and comparative financial data, maintaining robust supporting schedules, documentation and clear audit trails.
  • Deliver insightful variance analysis against budget, forecast and prior periods, identifying emerging cost trends, significant movements, financial risks and recommended corrective actions.
  • Oversee balance sheet reconciliations and key accounting entries, including accruals, prepayments, payroll, depreciation, revenue, stock and cost of goods sold (COGS).
  • Establish and embed effective financial controls, policies and processes that meet the needs of the current business while supporting future growth and scalability.
  • Oversee accounts payable and receivable, ensuring effective management of aged creditors, debtor collections, supplier payment schedules
  • Manage bank reconciliations and day-to-day banking operations
  • Cash flow forecasting-, provide visibility of liquidity requirements, upcoming financial commitments and any risks or actions requiring attention
  • Implement and maintain robust controls over expenses, vendor onboarding, supplier records and payment processes.
  • Review and approve payroll
  • Lead the Finance workstream for banking and payment infrastructure initiatives, including bank migrations, process improvements and changes to payment approval workflows.
  • Oversee working capital reporting across payables, receivables, inventory and other significant cash commitments, providing clear insight into financial risks, priorities and required actions.
  • Maintain robust financial controls over stock, including valuation, reconciliations, provisions and adjustments, ensuring the accuracy and consistency of inventory balances across all channels and locations.
  • Ensure the accurate and consistent accounting of cost of goods sold (COGS), landed costs, freight, duties and other inventory-related expenses.
  • Gross margin reporting, working closely with Merchandising, Production and Operations to investigate discrepancies and proactively identify margin erosion and inventory risks.
  • Ensure accuracy and reliability of financial data flowing between Retail 24/7, Shopify, Xero etc
  • Lead the year-end financial reporting process and annual audit
  • Oversee day-to-day Finance compliance, including VAT, PAYE/NIC, PSA/P11D and corporation tax reporting, liaising with external tax advisers etc
  • Manage and support multi-entity and international tax, VAT, customs and duty compliance as the business grows and expands into new markets.
  • Maintain a robust, well-organised and audit-ready Finance function, ensuring financial records and supporting documentation are readily available for investor, lender and other due diligence requirements.
  • Partner with department heads to strengthen financial accountability, scrutinise expenditure and ensure the financial impact of key decisions
  • Coordinate the annual budgeting and reforecasting processes, consolidating departmental inputs and constructively challenging assumptions to ensure realistic and robust financial plans.
  • Provide clear, actionable financial analysis across costs, margins, cash flow and profitability to inform operational priorities, commercial decisions and investment opportunities.
  • Financial forecasting, scenario planning and modelling
  • Automate processes and improve the use of financial data to drive efficiency
The Person:

·       Fully Qualified (ACA/ ACCA/ CIMA) with strong Financial controller, Senior           Finance manager or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrable experience managing the month-end close, monthly and quarterly financial reporting, balance sheet integrity, accounts payable and receivable, and year-end audit preparation.
  • Experience within an omnichannel consumer-facing business, ideally in the fashion industry, with a strong understanding of inventory management, working capital optimisation and gross margin performance.
  • Strong Excel skills, ideally Xero, Shopify and Retail 24/7

job.title: Strategy Director/Planning Lead
job.description:
Strategy Director / Planning Lead

London | £90,000-£100,000 | Full-time

We’re working with an independent creative agency looking for a senior strategic lead to take ownership of strategy across a number of key client relationships, while also helping shape the future of the agency’s planning offer.
This is a broad, hands-on role for an integrated strategist who is equally comfortable getting upstream into brand and audience strategy, turning insight into a sharp creative brief, developing shopper and activation thinking, or sitting alongside senior clients to help solve a business problem. 

The role spans brand, campaign, shopper, customer, social and activation strategy, with a strong focus on connecting strategic thinking to creative work and commercial outcomes. You’ll work closely with Creative, Account Management and agency leadership, and play an important role in new business, thought leadership and proposition development. 

A key part of the opportunity is helping the agency build a more AI-enabled approach to planning. That means using AI to support areas such as insight mining, research, competitor analysis, social listening, stimulus generation and first-draft outputs, while applying senior judgement to turn that into useful, distinctive strategic thinking. 

You’ll be responsible for:
  • Leading strategy across key client relationships
  • Working across brand, audience, campaign, shopper, social and activation planning
  • Running senior client conversations and strategic workshops
  • Turning complex business and behavioural challenges into clear strategic opportunities and creative briefs
  • Partnering closely with Creative to strengthen the work
  • Contributing to pitches, new business and growth opportunities
  • Helping evolve the agency’s strategic proposition, products and thought leadership
  • Shaping AI-enabled planning tools, workflows and ways of working
We’re looking for someone who:
  • Is already operating at Strategy Director level, or is a strong Associate Strategy Director ready for greater ownership
  • Comes from an integrated, creative or activation agency background
  • Has experience beyond traditional advertising, ideally across a mix of brand, shopper/customer, activation, social, experiential and digital
  • Is strong at turning research and complexity into simple, compelling strategic stories
  • Can write briefs that genuinely inspire creative teams
  • Is confident with senior clients and comfortable facilitating workshops
  • Is commercially minded and able to spot opportunities beyond the immediate brief
  • Has strong new business experience
  • Is already using AI meaningfully in their work and interested in how it can improve the quality and efficiency of planning
  • Is happy being hands-on rather than managing a large planning team

job.title: Social & Cultural Insights Analyst (Talent Pool)
job.description:

If you're interested in being contacted about roles similar to the opportunity outlined below, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your latest CV, and a member of our team will be in touch if we have a suitable opportunity that matches your experience and career goals.


Social & Cultural Insights Analyst
Location: London
Working pattern: Hybrid
Environment: Creative / Social Agency

About the Role
We're looking for a curious and culturally plugged-in Social & Cultural Insights Analyst to join a growing creative agency.
This is an agency-side role for someone who is fascinated by what people are talking about, how culture is changing and what those shifts mean for brands.
You'll combine social listening, data, research and cultural trends to uncover insights that help shape client strategy, creative ideas and campaigns. You'll work closely with strategists, creatives and account teams, helping turn data and cultural intelligence into clear, actionable thinking for clients.

Key Responsibilities
  • Monitor social platforms, online communities, media and cultural conversations to identify emerging trends, behaviours and cultural movements
  • Use social listening, analytics and research tools to understand audiences, sentiment, conversations and cultural shifts
  • Analyse social and consumer data and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for clients
  • Identify emerging cultural moments and trends that could be relevant to brands and audiences
  • Create reports, presentations and dashboards to communicate key findings and recommendations
  • Support strategic and creative development through research and insight
  • Partner with strategists and creative teams to ensure ideas are culturally relevant and grounded in audience understanding
  • Monitor brand and competitor conversations across social and digital channels
  • Analyse campaign performance and social/cultural impact, identifying opportunities for optimisation
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to both internal teams and clients
  • Stay constantly curious about social media, online communities, consumer behaviour and wider culture


About You
We're interested in candidates with 3+ years' experience across areas such as:
  • Social Insights
  • Cultural Insights / Cultural Strategy
  • Social Listening
  • Consumer Insights
  • Audience Intelligence
  • Social Analytics
  • Data & Insights
  • Trend Research


You'll ideally have:
  • Experience working within an agency, consultancy or similar client-facing environment
  • Experience using social listening or analytics platforms such as Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Sprinklr, NetBase or similar
  • A strong understanding of social media and digital culture
  • Excellent research and analytical skills
  • The ability to turn data and research into clear, compelling insights
  • A genuine curiosity about culture, trends, audiences and consumer behaviour
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Confidence working with clients and presenting insight
  • The ability to collaborate closely with strategy, creative and account teams
  • A balance of analytical and creative thinking


The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to join a fast-paced creative agency and work across a range of brands and briefs.
You'll have the opportunity to influence client strategy and creative thinking by bringing a strong understanding of social, culture, trends and consumer behaviour to the table.
If you're someone who is constantly spotting the next trend, questioning why people behave the way they do and enjoys turning data into a story, we'd love to hear from you.
